title: India vs England
overview: India vs England is an upcoming Indian Kannada-language Romantic Thriller film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekar and produced by Y.N.Shankaregowda and several Non resident Indians from the UK and other countries. The film stars Vasishta Simha and Manvitha Harish. The film is set to release on 24 January 2020.
